text:
Maya H: heads up - after the keystore RBAC update this morning a few premerge SAST runs started failing with 'keystore: access denied'. blocked merges. anyone else seeing this?

Chris L: yup, just noticed. CI logs show `ERROR: KMSDecryptDenied` when the scan runner tries to sign evidence blobs. reproduction: run the GH action locally without the updated SA mapping.

Samir: that was the change that replaced `keystore-reader` -> `keystore-reader-v2`, right? new role omitted `cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` binding for CI service account.

Maya H: correct. PR 4521 introduced the new role. compliance flagged the prior role for being too broad so infra narrowed it and forgot the scan path.

SecurityBot: [scan-upload 2026-03-10T09:12Z] SAST run attached: 18 findings, 2 gating failures. Link: https://redwood-internal/scans/4521

Eli: quick triage here - most findings are fine but two gating failures are blocked because evidence signing couldn't attach provenance metadata. the SAST job treats missing-signed-evidence as gate-blocking.

Priya K: operational question: should we use a dedicated `scan-evidence-sa` that has minimal KMS decrypt rights and map GH actions to impersonate it via workload identity? keeps CI stable during future RBAC tweaks.

Chris L: we actually have `scan-evidence-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` but GH workflows are hard-coded to `CI_SERVICE_ACCOUNT`. changing the env var in `.github/workflows/sast.yml` is the fastest fix.

Samir: before switching, we need to ensure audit provenance: compliance requires the keystore audit entry to show a human-traceable principal (or a short-lived mapping). ephemeral impersonation is OK if we emit a mapping record to the audit log or to a signed attestation.

Maya H: can we tag keystore ops with a custom attribute in audit logs? our KMS audit entries include the actor service account email, but not downstream pipeline IDs. we need a way to correlate.

Eli: on GCP we can enable Data Access audit logs for KMS and include the serviceAccountName. For extra correlation add the GH run id in the request metadata (if the client supports x-goog-request-params) or store mapping in a small audit table during the workflow run.

Chris L: local repro snippet:```
export SA=scan-evidence-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# grant workload identity binding for GH actions
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding $SA \
  --member="serviceAccount:redwood-github.svc.id.goog[redwood/actions]" \
  --role="roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser"
# grant KMS decrypt on the key used to sign evidence
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/keystore \
  --member=serviceAccount:$SA \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```

Priya K: i'll update the RBAC doc and the SDLC playbook with a section on 'evidence-sa' mapping and audit expectations. i can also own a short runbook for temporary exceptions.

Samir: let's also add a small CI change so keystore failures are non-fatal for non-evidence findings (reduce noise). open a GH issue: redwood/sast#78 for behaviour change.

Maya H: plan: 1) small PR to switch GH workflow to `scan-evidence-sa` (i'm on it), 2) infra to apply the KMS binding, 3) Eli runs signing dry-run and posts sanitized keystore audit snippet here, 4) close temporary gating exception.

SecurityBot: [policy] Temporary gating exception created: EXC-2026-0310-9 by Maya H (expires in 1h)

Eli: will post audit snippet once dry-run completes. pls coordinate before rolling role changes back.

Chris L: thanks. also echo that any RBAC tightening should be coordinated with the SDLC team so scan tooling owners aren't surprised. small doc update could prevent this recurring. :thumbsup:
